# Marters & Co.

> Marters & Co. is a boutique AI and automation consultancy in Dubai, licensed
> in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), UAE. It automates
> repetitive tasks, connects business systems and builds practical AI tools for
> small and mid-sized businesses across the UAE and the wider Gulf (GCC).
> Established 2026.

Registered name: Marters & Co. Applied Intelligence Ltd. Work starts with a
fixed-fee Discovery Audit; the team that scopes a project is the team that
builds and hands it over, and clients own the software, source code and
accounts.

## Services

- **Discovery Audit** — 2–3 weeks, fixed scope and fixed fee, no obligation to
  continue. A review of daily work that produces a prioritised plan: what to
  automate, what it will cost and how much time it could save.
- **Automate repetitive tasks** — Data entry, document preparation and routine
  admin. Examples: invoice matching, payroll files, packing lists.
- **Connect your systems** — Accounting, sales, stock and HR software linked so
  information moves automatically. Examples: online sales into the ERP, stock
  updates, accounting integrations.
- **Build custom software** — Internal tools, reporting dashboards and document
  generators, delivered with source code and accounts owned by the client.
- **Put AI to work** — AI tools that read documents, find company information
  and assist with routine decisions, with staff reviewing results where needed.
  Examples: PDF data extraction, company knowledge assistants, email sorting.
- **Staff training** — Practical training on the tools a team uses, with
  step-by-step guides.
- **AI workshops** — Hands-on sessions for teams and leaders: AI basics,
  practical prompting, leadership briefings.
- **Ongoing support** — Optional monthly support: monitoring, fixes and
  improvements to systems the firm has built.

## How engagements run

1. **Discover** — Discovery Audit (2–3 weeks). Observe daily work, speak to
   staff, assess where automation helps. Output: a process map, business case
   and prioritised plan.
2. **Build** — One workflow at a time, connected to existing tools and run
   alongside the old process until the results match.
3. **Embed** — Staff training, simple written instructions, measured results,
   full handover of software and accounts. Optional ongoing support.

## Pricing

- Discovery Audit: fixed fee, agreed before work starts.
- Builds: quoted per project or workflow, after the audit.
- Ongoing support: agreed monthly fee.
- The first conversation is free.

## Who it is for

Small and mid-sized businesses in the UAE and the wider Gulf, most often in
trading and distribution, export, logistics, professional services and clinics.
Typical starting points are finance, stock, sales-entry, payroll and
procurement processes that involve manual re-entry between systems.

## Past work

Eight past projects and two illustrative ideas are described at
https://martersandco.com/past-work. Client names are kept private. Examples:

- Automatic export packing lists — about 7 hours of manual preparation removed
  per export.
- Marketplace and online sales posted into the ERP daily — about 5 hours saved
  per former manual entry run.
- Internal stock transfers and manufacturing entries from one spreadsheet —
  about 3 hours saved per transfer.
- Payment-file sales reconciliation — about 2 hours saved per payment run.
- Stock forecasting — out-of-stock rate down 15%; forecasts on demand instead
  of 12–15 hours of preparation.
- UAE WPS payroll bank file generation — a five-hour task reduced to seconds.
- AI inbox triage for sales orders, with human review retained.
- Practical AI workshop for a team, built around their own roles.

Figures describe the individual projects, not a promised result. The finance
anomaly review and supplier-quote comparison examples are illustrative ideas
with no measured client outcome and should not be described as delivered work.
